title: Rigour Without Infrastructure: Three Propositions on Claim-Card Discipline as a Substitute for Institutional Certification

equations.label: (unnumbered, Sec.1)
equations.meaning: The lens never grants direct access to reality (W), only to what was read out; the reader's readout R_A under policy Pi_A is not identical to the world W.
equations.paper_tier: definition (readout-not-truth notation, inherited from Readout Universe/Readout Genesis)

equations.label: (unnumbered, Sec.3.3)
equations.meaning: A claim-card field that is mechanically presence-checkable (Q1-Q4) is not thereby correctness-checkable; only Q5 (independent check) can close that gap.

equations.label: (unnumbered, Sec.8.1, disclaimer D-DVP-NOT-K2)
equations.meaning: A decorrelated-vendor AI review pass (DVP) is at most an I3 route; no amount of AI-only cross-checking raises a claim to K2 (independent human-validated) status.

equations.label: (unnumbered, Sec.9 / Appendix disclaimer D-AUTHORSHIP)
equations.meaning: AI drafting, retrieval, or analysis never substitutes for the human author's final judgment and responsibility for a claim.
